mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corp_gr , t1.load_date AS load_date , t1.ip_user AS ip_user , fw.user_nm AS user_nm , t1.load_ok AS load_ok , t1.load_naye AS load_naye , t1.load_ymd AS load_ymd FROM LOAD_STATUS t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN FW_USER_MST fw ON fw.enc_e_mail = TO_ENCRYPTS(t1.ip_user) WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND TRUNC(t1.load_ymd) = #{ymd} ORDER BY t1.load_seq DESC

SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corp_gr , t1.tr_ymd AS load_ymd , t1.tr_seq AS tr_seq , t1.fund_cd AS fund_cd , t1.jm_cd AS jm_cd , t1.jm_nm AS jm_nm , t1.currency AS currency , t1.stock_nm AS stock_nm , t1.tr_nm AS tr_nm , t1.meme_ymd AS meme_ymd , t1.gyul_ymd AS gyul_ymd , t1.tr_jusu AS tr_jusu , t1.tr_danga AS tr_danga , t1.tr_susu AS tr_susu , t1.tr_tax AS tr_tax , t1.tr_aek AS tr_aek , t1.meme_gijun_rt AS meme_gijun_rt , t1.gyul_gijun_rt AS gyul_gijun_rt , t1.load_dt AS load_dt , '1' AS load_ok FROM SYT0MG_LOAD t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.tr_ymd = #{ymd} ORDER BY t1.tr_seq

SELECT '2' AS s1 , '현금' AS jasan_nm , t1.fund_cd AS fund_cd , ia.fund_nm AS fund_nm , t1.jm_cd AS jm_cd , F_JM_NM(t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) AS jm_nm , t1.aekm AS aekm , t1.chui_aek AS chui_aek , t1.siga_aek AS siga_aek , '0' AS load_ok FROM SHM0HM_SIGA t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = #{ymd} UNION ALL SELECT '3' , '주식' , t1.fund_cd , ia.fund_nm , t1.jm_cd , F_JM_NM(t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) , t1.jusu , t1.chui_aek , t1.siga_aek , '0' FROM SJM0JM_SIGA t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = #{ymd} UNION ALL SELECT '1' , '채권' , t1.fund_cd , ia.fund_nm , t1.jm_cd , F_JM_NM(t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) , t1.aekm , t1.chui_aek , t1.siga_aek , '0' FROM SCM0CM_SIGA t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = #{ymd} UNION ALL SELECT '4' , '펀드' , t1.fund_cd , ia.fund_nm , t1.jm_cd , F_JM_NM(t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) , t1.jwa , t1.chui_aek , t1.siga_aek , '0' FROM SJM5SM_SIGA t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = #{ymd} ORDER BY 1, 3, 5
